title: "06. Stream-scoped DEM file discovery"
output: rmarkdown::html_vignette
vignette: >
  %\VignetteIndexEntry{06. Stream-scoped DEM file discovery}
  %\VignetteEngine{knitr::rmarkdown}
  %\VignetteEncoding{UTF-8}
---

This step connects planned DEM collections to provider file metadata for a saved
Stream polygon. It does not download rasters or create terrain assets/Events.
Study Area discovery remains broader; high-resolution acquisition is Stream-scoped.
Possible mid-resolution Study Area terrain is a separate future workflow.

| Action | Call path | State effect |
|---|---|---|
| Choose Stream/collection | `stream_dem_files_server` reads current Stream sf and explicit DEM plan | Invalidates previous file results |
| Find | `launch_stream_dem_job` → callr → `fluvgeo::discover_stream_dem_files` | Session-only metadata result |
| Resolve | TNM products → exact source-directory match → sf intersection | No guessed collection membership |
| Inspect bounds | child `aoi()` / `files()` → parent shared Leaflet map | Green Stream AOI, purple checked file bounds |
| Save choices | `store$save_dem_files` → `fluvgeo::write_stream_dem_selection` | Immutable file-choice snapshot |
| Reopen | `store$dem_files` → `fluvgeo::read_stream_dem_selection` | Offline read; only current context/source evidence restored |
| Switch/revise/cancel | worker kill and result invalidation | No file writes or stale AOI reuse |

The backend queries OPR or 1 m products only for supported USGS directory links.
It filters metadata bounding boxes, not actual valid-elevation footprints.
COMPLETE is catalog-query completion, not terrain coverage; PARTIAL denotes the
bounded record cap. FAILED and UNSUPPORTED are not evidence of no available DEMs.
No browser-supplied URL is fetched: endpoints are fixed and collection evidence
comes from the server-held discovery. Unknown resolution/size stays unknown.
Publication date is not survey date. No default scientific suitability follows.

The child `output$acquisition` presents a collapsible download review from the
current checked files, with saved-state comparison. Reported byte sizes are not
measured transfer sizes; missing values produce a known subtotal, not a complete
estimate. Unknown resolution stays unknown and coarser-than-1-m tiles are flagged.
This does not execute transfers. Empty results explain that a collection found
for the Study Area may not have any matching tiles for this Stream.

The child module manages a cancellable worker, 90-second outer timeout and
45-second request timeout. Changing context revision, discovery, planned candidates,
Stream or collection cancels and clears it, then restores any compatible saved
file choices. Checkboxes remain draft until Save file choices; Select all and Clear
update the same control. Save requires the persisted DEM acquisition plan and
matching source snapshot/raw metadata, Stream geometry and current revision.
Per-pair hashed filenames plus revision tokens prevent stale overwrite; historical
snapshots remain. Switching Stream/collection discards unsaved checkbox drafts.
PARTIAL remains partial even after Select all. The parent owns the one shared map and swaps overlays
when the DEM files tab is active; study geometry and selection snapshots are unchanged.

Sources: `R/stream_dem_files.R`, `R/mod_survey_collections.R`, sibling
`fluvgeo/R/discover_stream_dem_files.R`, `fluvgeo/R/stream_dem_selection.R` and
`R/study_store.R`. Tests: `test-stream-dem-files.R` in Studio,
`test_stream_dem_files.R` in fluvgeo. Opt-in public smoke check:
`dev/scripts/check-stream-dem-files-live.R`. ADR 0007 records the terrain scope and
future multi-source Stream Event/Reach derivative design boundaries.
